description: Vault log (PROTOCOL.md §7). Rebuild each message from `entry` and `previousHash`, compare with `message`, check the chain, the signature with the author's keys of `authorKeyVersion` (identity.json), the rules of §7.2 and §7.3, and each checkpoint root against its leaves. Every negative log must be refused at `failSeq` with `reason`; its entries are otherwise validly signed.

negatives.name: broken-chain
negatives.note: entry 2 names a previous hash that is not entry 1

negatives.name: bad-signature
negatives.note: entry 2 signed by Bob, authored by the owner

negatives.name: removal-outside-rotation
negatives.note: removing someone else needs a rotation request

negatives.name: demotion-without-checkpoint
negatives.note: Bob loses the right to write, so the entry needs a checkpoint

negatives.name: unfinished-request
negatives.note: the log ends inside a rotation request

negatives.name: unexpected-field
negatives.note: key_rotated must not set a role

negatives.name: no-owner
negatives.note: the owner lowers their own role and leaves the vault without an owner

negatives.name: unchained-key-replacement
negatives.note: no key statement makes these keys Bob's version 2

negatives.name: replaced-keys-sign
negatives.note: after member_keys_replaced, the owner's version-1 keys carry no rights

negatives.name: share-someone-elses-node
negatives.note: only the node's owner, whose id it derives from, may share it

negatives.name: share-into-home
negatives.note: a node is valid in its home already and is never shared into it

negatives.name: share-unsorted-names
negatives.note: names are listed in ascending byte order, without repeats

negatives.name: create-someone-elses-node
negatives.note: a node derives from its creator, so nobody creates another's

negatives.name: create-a-node-twice
negatives.note: a node is created in its home once

negatives.name: checkpoint-leaves-mismatch
negatives.note: the served leaves do not give the signed root
